component.name: Click'n'Translate
component.summary: Recognize and translate text anywhere on your screen

description.p: Click'n'Translate combines screen capture, OCR, online and offline translation, document translation, language packages, and local history in one desktop application.
Capture an area, translate the full screen, copy text that cannot be selected, or translate the current selection without interrupting your workflow.
Faster OCR startup, reliable system OCR discovery, and window toggle shortcuts.
